description: List the account's email drafts, newest first, with each draft's review state (`pending_review`, `approved`, `rejected`, `sent`), the reviewer's note and — once sent — the relay's Message-ID. Drafts are written by `create_draft` and approved or rejected by a person in the dashboard; nothing here sends. Filter by `status` to find the ones still waiting, or by `domainId` for one sending domain.

domainId.description: Optional: only drafts on this sending domain.

status.description: Optional: only drafts in this state.

name: list_drafts
